# pPreProc 2.5.2-rc.1

This is the first standalone Windows release candidate of pPreProc. It is
published for installation and workflow validation before the stable 2.5.2
release.

## Highlights

- Packages pParse2+ 2.5.2 with the required pParse, pXtract, model, and
  vendor-reader runtimes previously distributed through pFind 3.2.3.
- Keeps the application runtime separate from the public PFB/PFC SDK and
  interface source.
- Includes application terms, third-party notices, runtime provenance, a
  machine-readable component inventory, file-level hashes, and an archive
  checksum.

## Installation

1. Download `pPreProc-2.5.2-rc.1-windows-x64.zip` and its `.sha256` file.
2. Verify the ZIP checksum, then extract the archive to a writable directory.
3. In PowerShell, run `./ppreproc.ps1 -Version`.
4. Run a preprocessing job with `./ppreproc.ps1 -Input D:\data\sample.raw`
   or provide a configuration using `-Config`.

## Compatibility

- Windows x64
- .NET Framework 4.8
- PFB/PFC format v1
- Python and C++ PFB/PFC SDK 1.0.x
- End-to-end DDA workflow validated; DIA-specific precursor processing remains
  under development

## Known issues

- This release candidate is not code-signed.
- Vendor-format behavior should be validated on the intended clean workstation
  before production use.

## License and support

The application license, public-component license, and third-party notices are
included in the archive. Report reproducible defects through
https://github.com/crf-pfind/pPreProc/issues without attaching restricted
vendor data.
